verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents a first-party Agent testing feature that verifies conversational responses, tool usage and full multi-turn outcomes before deployment, and real conversations can be turned into test cases. Separate success-evaluation criteria score conversations, but those apply to completed conversations rather than pre-deploy tests. Missing for 10: detail on how simulated users/personas are configured, how tests run in CI or via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test agents with simulated conversations or evals before putting them on real phone calls

citations.quote: Agent testing lets you verify conversational responses, tool usage, and full multi-turn outcomes before you deploy.
Transform real conversations into test cases when you find an interaction where the agent underperformed.
Success evaluation: Define custom criteria to assess conversation quality, goal achievement, and customer satisfaction
